A silicon P-N junction is shown in the figure. The doping in the P region is \( 5 \times 10^{16} \, \text{cm}^{-3} \) and doping in the N region is \( 10 \times 10^{16} \, \text{cm}^{-3} \). The parameters given are:
- Built-in voltage (\( \Phi_{bi} \)) = 0.8 V
- Electron charge (\( q \)) = \( 1.6 \times 10^{-19} \) C
- Vacuum permittivity (\( \epsilon_0 \)) = \( 8.85 \times 10^{-12} \, \text{F/m} \)
- Relative permittivity of silicon (\( \epsilon_{si} \)) = 12

The magnitude of reverse bias voltage that would completely deplete one of the two regions (P or N) prior to the other (rounded off to one decimal place) is ______ V.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a rectangular silicon P-N junction, with the left side labeled as the P region, the right side labeled as the N region, and a vertical junction surface in the middle; the dimension line below shows that the width of the P region from the left boundary to the junction surface is 1.2 μm, and the width of the N region from the junction surface to the right boundary is 0.2 μm. Then reason: Take N_A = 5×10^16 cm^-3 = 5×10^22 m^-3, N_D = 10×10^16 cm^-3 = 1×10^23 m^-3, ε_s = ε_si ε_0 = 12×8.85×10^-12 = 1.062×10^-10 F/m. From depletion-region charge neutrality N_A x_p = N_D x_n, so x_p/x_n = N_D/N_A = 2. If the N region is first depleted to x_n = 0.2 μm, then the P-region depletion width x_p = 0.4 μm, which is less than the available P-region width 1.2 μm in the figure; if the P region is depleted to 1.2 μm, then the corresponding x_n = 0.6 μm, exceeding the N region 0.2 μm. Therefore the N region is completely depleted first. For an abrupt junction, x_n^2 = [2 ε_s V_J / q] · [N_A / (N_D(N_A+N_D))], where V_J = Φ_bi + V_R. Solving gives V_J = x_n^2 q N_D(N_A+N_D)/(2 ε_s N_A). Substitute x_n = 0.2 μm = 2×10^-7 m: V_J = (2×10^-7)^2(1.6×10^-19)(1×10^23)(1.5×10^23)/(2(1.062×10^-10)(5×10^22)) ≈ 9.04 V. Therefore V_R = V_J - Φ_bi = 9.04 - 0.8 ≈ 8.24 V, rounded to one decimal place as 8.2 V.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个横向的硅 P-N 结矩形结构，左侧区域标为 P，右侧区域标为 N。下方尺寸标注显示，P 区宽度为 1.2 μm，N 区宽度为 0.2 μm，结位于两区域交界处。

推理：给定 P 区掺杂浓度 N_A = 5 × 10^16 cm^-3，N 区掺杂浓度 N_D = 10 × 10^16 cm^-3，因此 N_D = 2N_A。耗尽区电荷平衡要求 N_A x_p = N_D x_n，所以 x_p = 2x_n。若 N 区先被完全耗尽，则 x_n = 0.2 μm，对应 x_p = 0.4 μm，小于 P 区总宽度 1.2 μm，因此可行。若 P 区先完全耗尽，则 x_p = 1.2 μm，对应 x_n = 0.6 μm，大于 N 区宽度 0.2 μm，因此不可行。所以 N 区先完全耗尽。

此时 x_n = 0.2 μm = 2 × 10^-7 m，x_p = 0.4 μm = 4 × 10^-7 m。掺杂浓度换算为 N_A = 5 × 10^22 m^-3，N_D = 1 × 10^23 m^-3。硅介电常数 ε_s = 12ε_0 = 12 × 8.85 × 10^-12 = 1.062 × 10^-10 F/m。

由泊松方程，总势垒电压为 V_total = q/(2ε_s) × (N_A x_p^2 + N_D x_n^2)。代入得 N_A x_p^2 = 5 × 10^22 × (4 × 10^-7)^2 = 8 × 10^9，N_D x_n^2 = 1 × 10^23 × (2 × 10^-7)^2 = 4 × 10^9，总和为 1.2 × 10^10。因此 V_total = [1.6 × 10^-19 / (2 × 1.062 × 10^-10)] × 1.2 × 10^10 ≈ 9.04 V。反偏电压大小 V_R = V_total - Φ_bi = 9.04 - 0.8 = 8.24 V，四舍五入到一位小数为 8.2 V。

由泊松方程，总势垒电压为 V_total = q/(2ε_s) × (N_A x_p^2 + N_D x_n^2)。代入得 N_A x_p^2 = 5 × 10^22 × (4 × 10^-7)^2 = 8 × 10^9，N_D x_n^2 = 1 × 10^23 × (2 × 10^-7)^2 = 4 × 10^9，总和为 1.2 × 10^10。因此 V_total = [1.6 × 10^-19 / (2 × 1.062 × 10^-10)] × 1.2 × 10^10 ≈ 9.04 V。反偏电压大小 V_R = V_total - Φ_bi = 9.04 - 0.8 = 8.24 V，四舍五入到一位小数为 8.2 V。

Therefore the N region is completely depleted first. For an abrupt junction, x_n^2 = [2 ε_s V_J / q] · [N_A / (N_D(N_A+N_D))], where V_J = Φ_bi + V_R. Therefore V_R = V_J - Φ_bi = 9.04 - 0.8 ≈ 8.24 V, rounded to one decimal place as 8.2 V.
